```{=html}
<style>
.w065 { max-width: 620px; margin: 0 auto; font-size: 0.9rem; }
.w065 .w065-list { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; margin-bottom: 0.75rem; }
.w065 .w065-q { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; }
.w065 .w065-label { font-weight: 600; }
.w065 .w065-in {
  max-width: 300px; padding: 5px 10px; border-radius: 6px; font-size: 0.9rem;
  border: 2px solid var(--bs-border-color, #999);
  background: var(--bs-body-bg, #fff); color: var(--bs-body-color, #222);
}
.w065 .w065-in.w065-right { border-color: #2e7d32; }
.w065 .w065-in.w065-wrong { border-color: #d81e2e; }
.w065 .w065-controls { display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.w065 .w065-controls button {
  padding: 5px 14px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--bs-border-color, #999);
  background: var(--bs-body-bg, #fff); color: var(--bs-body-color, #222); cursor: pointer;
}
.w065 .w065-note { font-size: 0.78rem; opacity: 0.7; font-style: italic; }
.w065 .w065-msg { font-weight: 700; min-height: 1.4em; text-align: center; margin-top: 0.5rem; }
.w065 .w065-msg.ok { color: #2e7d32; }
.w065 .w065-msg.bad { color: #d81e2e; }
.w065 .w065-expl { font-size: 0.85rem; opacity: 0.85; border-left: 3px solid #2e7d32; padding: 6px 10px; margin-top: 8px; }
</style>
<div class="w065 iw" id="w065">
  <div class="w065-list"></div>
  <div class="w065-controls">
    <button type="button" class="w065-check iw-check">Check</button>
    <button type="button" class="w065-reset iw-reset">Reset</button>
    <button type="button" class="w065-solution iw-solution">Show solution</button>
    <span class="w065-note">(no fun if you click it right away)</span>
  </div>
  <div class="w065-msg iw-msg" role="status"></div>
  <div class="w065-expl iw-expl" hidden>
    Comer&rsquo;s three principles for remote access: a VPN forms an encrypted connection to the organisation&rsquo;s cloud data centre and routes all of a device&rsquo;s packets through it, protecting the whole connection where TLS protects one application&rsquo;s; whole-disk encryption keeps the business data on a lost laptop or phone confidential at rest; and workflow security makes the security policy travel with the data as it moves between cloud and device &mdash; see <a href="#sec-06-vpns-data-on-move">the section on VPNs and data on the move</a>.
  </div>
</div>
<script>
(function () {
  const root = document.getElementById('w065');
  const list = root.querySelector('.w065-list');
  const msg = root.querySelector('.w065-msg');
  const expl = root.querySelector('.w065-expl');
  const QS = [
    {
      q: '1. Employees work from home and public Wi-Fi. Which control forms an encrypted connection to the organisation’s cloud data centre and routes all of a device’s packets through it?',
      accept: ['vpn', 'virtual private network'],
      canon: 'VPN'
    },
    {
      q: '2. A laptop or phone can be lost. Which at-rest control keeps the business data stored on the device confidential?',
      accept: ['whole disk encryption', 'whole disk', 'full disk encryption', 'full disk', 'disk encryption', 'device encryption'],
      canon: 'whole-disk encryption'
    },
    {
      q: '3. Comer’s third principle: the security policy for a piece of data travels with the data as it moves between cloud and device — enforcing … security:',
      accept: ['workflow'],
      canon: 'workflow'
    }
  ];
  function norm(s) {
    return (s || '').toLowerCase().replace(/[-_.,;:!?'"()]/g, ' ').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
  }
  function inputs() { return [...root.querySelectorAll('.w065-in')]; }
  function clearMarks() {
    inputs().forEach(i => i.classList.remove('w065-right', 'w065-wrong'));
    msg.textContent = ''; msg.className = 'w065-msg iw-msg';
  }
  QS.forEach((it, i) => {
    const q = document.createElement('div');
    q.className = 'w065-q';
    const lab = document.createElement('label');
    lab.className = 'w065-label';
    lab.textContent = it.q;
    lab.setAttribute('for', 'w065-in-' + i);
    const inp = document.createElement('input');
    inp.type = 'text';
    inp.id = 'w065-in-' + i;
    inp.className = 'w065-in';
    inp.dataset.k = String(i);
    inp.autocomplete = 'off';
    inp.addEventListener('input', clearMarks);
    q.appendChild(lab); q.appendChild(inp);
    list.appendChild(q);
  });
  root.querySelector('.w065-check').addEventListener('click', () => {
    let right = 0, empty = 0;
    inputs().forEach(inp => {
      inp.classList.remove('w065-right', 'w065-wrong');
      const v = norm(inp.value);
      if (!v) { empty++; return; }
      const acc = QS[Number(inp.dataset.k)].accept;
      const hit = acc.some(a => v === a || (' ' + v + ' ').indexOf(' ' + a + ' ') !== -1);
      if (hit) { inp.classList.add('w065-right'); right++; }
      else inp.classList.add('w065-wrong');
    });
    if (right === QS.length) { msg.textContent = '✓ All correct — confidentiality follows the data across every hop.'; msg.className = 'w065-msg iw-msg ok'; }
    else if (empty > 0 && right + empty === QS.length) { msg.textContent = 'Keep going — ' + empty + ' answer(s) still empty.'; msg.className = 'w065-msg iw-msg'; }
    else { msg.textContent = '✗ Not yet — ' + right + ' of ' + QS.length + ' answers are right; the red ones need another look at the chapter.'; msg.className = 'w065-msg iw-msg bad'; }
  });
  root.querySelector('.w065-reset').addEventListener('click', () => {
    inputs().forEach(i => { i.value = ''; });
    clearMarks();
    expl.hidden = true;
  });
  root.querySelector('.w065-solution').addEventListener('click', () => {
    inputs().forEach(inp => {
      inp.value = QS[Number(inp.dataset.k)].canon;
      inp.classList.remove('w065-wrong');
      inp.classList.add('w065-right');
    });
    msg.textContent = 'Solution shown — reset to try it yourself.';
    msg.className = 'w065-msg iw-msg ok';
    expl.hidden = false;
  });
})();
</script>
```
